title: XRPL Standards XLS-0033: Multi-Purpose Tokens (MPTs)
key_points: Proposal for multi-purpose tokens to replace trust lines, reducing storage requirements.
Introduces new data structures and transactions for MPT issuance, management, and trading.
MPTs have advantages like simpler conceptual model and reduced infrastructure burdens but also disadvantages like introducing a third asset type.
limitations: Currently covers only basic MPT functionalities; future amendments will integrate with other XRPL features.
Does not introduce cross-currency payments yet.
asserts: This proposal introduces extensions to the XRP Ledger to support a more multi-purpose token type as an alternative to trust lines.
scope: The scope of this proposal is the XRP Ledger and its community, aiming to improve ledger stability and scalability through the introduction of MPTs.
